title.sk: Bangers and mash – klobásky s kašou a cibuľovou omáčkou
title.en: Bangers and mash with onion gravy

description.sk: Britská krčmová klasika: opečené klobásky na maslovej kaši s horčicou a sladkou cibuľovou omáčkou.
description.en: A British pub classic: browned sausages on buttery mustard mash with a sweet onion gravy.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj a var v osolenej vode (¼ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska.
steps.en: Peel and chop the potatoes and boil them in salted water (¼ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender. Slice the onions into thin half-moons.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a klobásky opekaj na strednom ohni 15 minút, často ich obracaj, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán hnedé a vnútri nemajú 71 °C. Neprepichuj ich, vytiekla by z nich šťava.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the sausages over a medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often, until browned all over and 71 °C inside. Do not prick them, or the juices run out.

steps.sk: Na inej panvici rozpusti polovicu masla, pridaj cibuľu, cukor a tymian a smaž na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým nie je cibuľa mäkká a zlatohnedá. Popráš ju múkou, prilej 300 ml vody s bujónom a sójovú omáčku a var 3 minúty do hustej omáčky.
steps.en: Melt half the butter in another pan, add the onions, sugar and thyme and cook gently for 15 minutes until soft and golden brown. Dust with the flour, pour in 300 ml water with the stock cube and the soy sauce and simmer for 3 minutes into a thick gravy.

steps.sk: Hrášok var 3 minúty vo vode. Zemiaky sceď, pridaj zvyšné maslo, horčicu a horúce mlieko a roztlač ich na hladkú kašu.
steps.en: Boil the peas for 3 minutes. Drain the potatoes, add the remaining butter, the mustard and hot milk and mash until smooth.

steps.sk: Na tanier daj kôpku kaše, polož k nej klobásky, prelej ich cibuľovou omáčkou a pridaj hrášok. Zvyšky vydržia v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Spoon a mound of mash onto each plate, lean the sausages against it, pour over the onion gravy and add the peas. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Toad in the hole – klobásky zapečené v cestíčku

description.sk: Klobásky zapečené v nadýchanom yorkshirskom ceste, s cibuľovou omáčkou a brokolicou.
description.en: Sausages baked in a puffed Yorkshire pudding batter, with onion gravy and broccoli.

steps.sk: Múku zmiešaj so soľou, vymiešaj s vajcami a postupne prilievaj mlieko, kým nevznikne hladké cesto ako na palacinky. Nechaj ho 20 minút odpočívať a rúru predhrej na 220 °C.
steps.en: Mix the flour with the salt, whisk in the eggs and gradually add the milk to make a smooth batter like a crêpe batter. Rest it for 20 minutes and preheat the oven to 220 °C.

steps.sk: Do pekáča s rozmermi asi 30 × 20 cm nalej olej, pridaj klobásky a peč ich 10 minút, kým nezačnú hnednúť a olej nie je rozpálený.
steps.en: Pour the oil into a roasting tin of about 30 × 20 cm, add the sausages and roast for 10 minutes until they start to brown and the oil is very hot.

steps.sk: Pekáč rýchlo vyber, cesto ešte raz premiešaj a vlej ho okolo klobások – na horúcom oleji musí hneď zasyčať. Vráť ho do rúry a peč 25 až 30 minút, kým cesto vysoko nevyrastie a nie je chrumkavé a hnedé. Počas pečenia rúru neotváraj, cesto by spľaslo.
steps.en: Quickly take out the tin, give the batter a stir and pour it around the sausages; it must sizzle as it hits the hot oil. Return it to the oven for 25 to 30 minutes until the batter is well risen, crisp and brown. Do not open the oven while it bakes, or it collapses.

steps.sk: Medzitým na masle opekaj na tenko nakrájanú cibuľu s tymianom 12 minút dozlatista, prilej 300 ml vody s bujónom a horčicou, okoreň a var 5 minút do omáčky. Brokolicu rozober na ružičky a var ju 4 minúty.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the thinly sliced onions with the thyme in the butter for 12 minutes until golden, add 300 ml water with the stock cube and the mustard, season with pepper and simmer for 5 minutes into a gravy. Break the broccoli into florets and boil for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Toad in the hole nakrájaj na porcie a podávaj hneď s cibuľovou omáčkou a brokolicou. Klobásky majú vnútri 71 °C. Cesto je najlepšie hneď po upečení, kým je chrumkavé.
steps.en: Cut into portions and serve straight away with the onion gravy and broccoli. The sausages should be 71 °C inside. The batter is best straight from the oven while crisp.

title.sk: Cornwallské taštičky s hovädzím a zemiakmi
title.en: Cornish pasties with beef and potato

description.sk: Polmesiace z maslového cesta plnené surovým hovädzím, zemiakmi a kalerábom, upečené vo vlastnej šťave.
description.en: Butter pastry half-moons filled with raw beef, potato and kohlrabi that bake in their own juices.

steps.sk: Múku zmiešaj s ½ lyžičky soli a rukami do nej rozotri studené maslo nakrájané na kocky, kým zmes nepripomína strúhanku. Pridaj asi 120 ml ľadovej vody a rýchlo spracuj na hladké cesto. Zabaľ ho a daj na 30 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Mix the flour with ½ teaspoon of salt and rub in the cold, diced butter with your fingertips until it looks like breadcrumbs. Add about 120 ml iced water and quickly bring it together into a smooth dough. Wrap and chill for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm, zemiaky a kaleráb ošúp a nakrájaj na tenké plátky 3 mm a cibuľu nadrobno. Všetko premiešaj so zvyšnou soľou a hojným korením – plnka sa pečie surová a dusí sa vo vlastnej šťave.
steps.en: Cut the beef into 1 cm dice, peel the potato and kohlrabi and slice them 3 mm thin, and chop the onion finely. Toss everything with the remaining salt and plenty of pepper; the filling goes in raw and steams in its own juices.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cesto rozdeľ na 4 časti a každú rozvaľkaj na kruh s priemerom 22 cm. Plnku rozdeľ na polovice kruhov, okraje potri vajcom, prelož na polmesiac a okraj pevne zatoč, aby šťava nevytiekla.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Divide the pastry into 4 and roll each piece into a 22 cm circle. Pile the filling onto one half of each, brush the edges with egg, fold over into a half-moon and crimp the edge firmly so no juices escape.

steps.sk: Taštičky polož na plech s papierom, potri vajcom a do vrchu urob malý zárez na paru. Peč 20 minút pri 200 °C, potom zníž teplotu na 170 °C a peč ďalších 35 minút. Plnka je hotová, keď nôž zapichnutý cez zárez vojde bez odporu.
steps.en: Lay the pasties on a lined tray, brush with egg and cut a small steam hole in the top. Bake for 20 minutes at 200 °C, then lower the oven to 170 °C and bake for another 35 minutes. The filling is done when a knife pushed through the hole meets no resistance.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich 10 minút vychladnúť, vnútri sú veľmi horúce. V Cornwalle ich baníci jedli rukami; vychladnuté vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a upečené sa dajú zamraziť.
steps.en: Let them cool for 10 minutes, as they are very hot inside. Cornish miners ate them with their hands; cooled, they keep in the fridge for 3 days, and baked pasties freeze well.

title.sk: Kedgeree – kari ryža s lososom a vajcom
title.en: Kedgeree: curried rice with salmon and egg

description.sk: Anglo-indická ryža s kari, lupienkami lososa, hráškom, vajcom a petržlenovou vňaťou.
description.en: Anglo-Indian curried rice with flaked salmon, peas, egg and parsley.

steps.sk: Lososa vlož do panvice s mliekom a bobkovým listom, priveď do mierneho varu a var 5 minút. Nechaj ho 5 minút v mlieku dôjsť, potom ho vyber, stiahni kožu a rozober na väčšie lupienky. 150 ml mlieka si nechaj.
steps.en: Put the salmon in a frying pan with the milk and bay leaf, bring to a gentle simmer and poach for 5 minutes. Leave it in the milk for 5 minutes more, then lift it out, remove the skin and break into large flakes. Keep 150 ml of the milk.

steps.sk: Vajcia var 8 minút, schlaď ich a ošúp; žĺtky budú ešte jemne mäkké. Ryžu prepláchni do čírej vody.
steps.en: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel them; the yolks will still be slightly soft. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu na ňom speň 5 minút. Pridaj kari a kurkumu, miešaj 30 sekúnd, potom vsyp ryžu a minútu ju opekaj, aby sa obalila maslom.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pan and soften the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes. Add the curry powder and turmeric, stir for 30 seconds, then add the rice and toast it for a minute to coat in the butter.

steps.sk: Zalej ju 450 ml vody a 150 ml mlieka z ryby, pridaj soľ, priveď do varu, prikry a var na najmenšom ohni 12 minút. Posledné 3 minúty pridaj na ryžu hrášok.
steps.en: Pour in 450 ml water and 150 ml of the poaching milk, add the salt, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, adding the peas on top for the last 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Do ryže opatrne vmiešaj lososa, petržlenovú vňať a šťavu z polovice citróna, okoreň a navrch polož štvrtiny vajec. Podávaj s mesiačikmi citróna; zvyšky vydržia 1 deň v chladničke.
steps.en: Gently fold the salmon, parsley and the juice of half the lemon through the rice, season with pepper and top with the quartered eggs. Serve with lemon wedges; leftovers keep for 1 day in the fridge.

description.sk: Jemná krémová polievka z póru a zemiakov bez smotany, s pažítkou – lacná a do mrazničky.
description.en: A smooth, creamy leek and potato soup without cream, finished with chives; cheap and freezer friendly.

steps.sk: Pór pozdĺžne rozkroj, dôkladne umy medzi listami, kde býva piesok, a nakrájaj na polkolieska; tmavozelené tuhé konce odrež. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky, cibuľu a cesnak nadrobno.
steps.en: Halve the leeks lengthways, wash them well between the layers where grit hides and slice into half-moons, trimming off the tough dark green tops. Peel and dice the potatoes and finely chop the onion and garlic.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej olej, pridaj pór, cibuľu a štipku soli, prikry a nechaj na miernom ohni 10 minút potiť, kým nezmäknú – nemajú zhnednúť, polievka by stmavla. Pridaj cesnak na minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pan, add the leeks, onion and a pinch of salt, cover and sweat over a low heat for 10 minutes until soft; they should not brown, or the soup turns dark. Add the garlic for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky, 1,2 litra vody, bujón, tymian a bobkový list a var 20 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú úplne mäkké.
steps.en: Add the potatoes, 1.2 litres of water, the stock cube, thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are completely soft.

steps.sk: Bobkový list vyber a polievku rozmixuj ponorným mixérom dohladka. Ak je príliš hustá, prilej vodu. Dochuť zvyšnou soľou a korením.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaf and blend the soup smooth with a stick blender. Add water if it is too thick. Season with the remaining salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypanú pažítkou, s chlebom alebo krutónmi. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a v mrazničke 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Serve scattered with chives, with bread or croutons. The soup keeps in the fridge for 4 days and in the freezer for 3 months.

title.sk: Rybací koláč pod zemiakovou kašou (fish pie)
title.en: Fish pie with a mashed potato crust

description.sk: Treska a losos v krémovej petržlenovej omáčke so špenátom a vajcom, zapečené pod kašou so syrom.
description.en: Cod and salmon in a creamy parsley sauce with spinach and egg, baked under cheesy mash.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj a var v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka. Sceď ich a roztlač s 20 g masla, 150 ml horúceho mlieka a muškátovým orieškom na hladkú kašu. Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo a nakrájaj na štvrtiny.
steps.en: Peel and chop the potatoes and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with 20 g of the butter, 150 ml hot milk and the nutmeg until smooth. Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes and quarter them.

steps.sk: Rybu vlož do širokej panvice so 600 ml mlieka, cibuľou nakrájanou na hrubé plátky a bobkovým listom, priveď do mierneho varu a var 4 minúty. Rybu vyber a rozober na veľké kusy bez kože; mlieko preceď a odlož.
steps.en: Put the fish in a wide pan with 600 ml milk, the onion in thick slices and the bay leaf, bring to a gentle simmer and poach for 4 minutes. Lift out the fish and break it into large, skinless chunks; strain and keep the milk.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti zvyšné maslo, vmiešaj múku a minútu miešaj, potom postupne prilievaj rybacie mlieko a stále šľahaj, kým nevznikne hustá hladká omáčka. Var 3 minúty, pridaj horčicu, citrónovú šťavu, petržlenovú vňať, zvyšnú soľ a korenie a vmiešaj špenát, aby zvädol.
steps.en: Melt the remaining butter in a pan, stir in the flour for a minute, then gradually whisk in the poaching milk until you have a thick, smooth sauce. Simmer for 3 minutes, add the mustard, lemon juice, parsley, remaining salt and pepper and stir in the spinach to wilt.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Do zapekacej misy rozlož rybu, krevety, ak ich máš, a vajcia a prelej ich omáčkou. Navrch rozotri zemiakovú kašu, vidličkou urob ryhy a posyp ju strúhaným syrom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Spread the fish, the prawns if using, and the eggs in a baking dish and pour over the sauce. Spread the mash over the top, rough it up with a fork and sprinkle with the grated cheese.

steps.sk: Peč 25 až 30 minút, kým kaša navrchu nie je zlatohnedá a omáčka na okrajoch bublá. Nechaj 10 minút postáť a podávaj s hráškom alebo šalátom. Upečený koláč vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the mash is golden brown and the sauce bubbles at the edges. Let it stand for 10 minutes and serve with peas or a salad. The baked pie keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.en: Scotch broth with beef and barley

description.sk: Hustá hrejivá polievka z hovädzieho, krúp, hrachu a koreňovej zeleniny.
description.en: A thick, warming soup of beef, pearl barley, split peas and root vegetables.

steps.sk: Krúpy a hrach prepláchni a namoč na 30 minút do studenej vody. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, vlož ho do veľkého hrnca s 2,5 litra studenej vody a bobkovými listami a priveď do varu; zober penu.
steps.en: Rinse the barley and split peas and soak them in cold water for 30 minutes. Cut the beef into 2 cm cubes, put it in a large pot with 2.5 litres of cold water and the bay leaves and bring to the boil, skimming off the foam.

steps.sk: Pridaj scedené krúpy a hrach, bujón a tymian a var prikryté na miernom ohni 45 minút.
steps.en: Add the drained barley and peas, the stock cube and thyme and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 45 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým ošúp mrkvu, zeler a kaleráb a nakrájaj ich na kocky s hranou 1 cm, cibuľu nadrobno, pór na polkolieska a kapustu na rezance.
steps.en: Meanwhile, peel the carrots, celeriac and kohlrabi and cut them into 1 cm dice; chop the onion finely, slice the leek into half-moons and shred the cabbage.

steps.sk: Pridaj do hrnca zeleninu okrem kapusty a var ďalších 30 minút, potom pridaj kapustu, soľ a korenie a var ešte 10 minút, kým nie sú krúpy mäkké a mäso sa rozpadá.
steps.en: Add all the vegetables except the cabbage and simmer for another 30 minutes, then add the cabbage, salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes more until the barley is tender and the beef falls apart.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj petržlenovú vňať a podávaj s chlebom. Polievka je hustá ako guláš a na druhý deň ešte zhustne, preto pri ohrievaní prilej vodu. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Stir in the parsley and serve with bread. The soup is as thick as a stew and thickens further overnight, so add water when reheating. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Zapekané cestoviny s tuniakom a syrom

description.sk: Lacné sýte cestoviny s tuniakom, kukuricou a hráškom v syrovej omáčke so zlatou kôrkou.
description.en: A cheap, filling bake of pasta, tuna, sweetcorn and peas in cheese sauce under a golden crust.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cestoviny uvar vo vode s ½ lyžičkou soli o 2 minúty kratšie, než je na obale, a sceď ich. Tuniaka sceď a rozober vidličkou na kúsky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the pasta in water with ½ teaspoon of salt for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain. Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo a speň na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 4 minúty. Vmiešaj múku a minútu miešaj, potom postupne prilievaj mlieko a stále šľahaj, kým nevznikne hladká omáčka. Var ju 3 minúty.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pan and soften the finely chopped onion for 4 minutes. Stir in the flour for a minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Simmer the sauce for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Omáčku odstav a vmiešaj do nej dve tretiny syra, horčicu, zvyšnú soľ a korenie. Pridaj cestoviny, tuniaka, kukuricu a hrášok a premiešaj.
steps.en: Take the sauce off the heat and stir in two-thirds of the cheese, the mustard, remaining salt and the pepper. Add the pasta, tuna, sweetcorn and peas and mix well.

steps.sk: Zmes prelej do zapekacej misy, posyp zvyšným syrom zmiešaným so strúhankou a zapekaj 20 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatý a chrumkavý a omáčka na okrajoch bublá.
steps.en: Tip into a baking dish, scatter with the remaining cheese mixed with the breadcrumbs and bake for 20 minutes until golden and crisp on top and bubbling at the edges.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút postáť a podávaj so zeleným šalátom. Zapekané cestoviny vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a dobre sa prehrievajú v mikrovlnke.
steps.en: Let it stand for 5 minutes and serve with a green salad. The bake keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats well in the microwave.

title.sk: Caesar šalát s kuracím a krutónmi

description.sk: Chrumkavý šalát s opečeným kuracím, krutónmi a ľahším cesnakovým dresingom s parmezánom.
description.en: Crisp lettuce with seared chicken, croutons and a lighter garlic and parmesan dressing.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia posoľ, okoreň a opeč na lyžičke oleja na stredne silnom ohni 5 až 6 minút z každej strany, kým nemajú vnútri 74 °C. Nechaj ich 5 minút odpočinúť a nakrájaj na plátky.
steps.en: Season the chicken breasts with the salt and some pepper and fry them in a teaspoon of the oil over a medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until 74 °C inside. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, premiešaj s lyžicou oleja a opeč na panvici za častého miešania 4 minúty dozlatista a dochrumkava.
steps.en: Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes, toss with a tablespoon of oil and fry in a pan, stirring often, for 4 minutes until golden and crisp.

steps.sk: Na dresing prelisuj cesnak a rozmiešaj ho s jogurtom, majonézou, citrónovou šťavou, horčicou, sójovou omáčkou, zvyšným olejom, polovicou nastrúhaného parmezánu a korením. Má byť hustý ako smotana.
steps.en: For the dressing, crush the garlic and whisk it with the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, soy sauce, remaining oil, half the grated parmesan and pepper. It should be as thick as cream.

steps.sk: Šalát natrhaj na veľké kusy a premiešaj s dresingom tak, aby bol každý list obalený. Navrch daj kuracie mäso a krutóny.
steps.en: Tear the lettuce into large pieces and toss with the dressing until every leaf is coated. Top with the chicken and croutons.

steps.sk: Posyp zvyšným parmezánom a čerstvo mletým korením a podávaj hneď. Do krabičky ho bal bez dresingu a krutónov; opečené mäso vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Scatter with the remaining parmesan and freshly ground pepper and serve straight away. For a packed lunch, keep the dressing and croutons separate; the cooked chicken keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Proteínová miska s morčacím, quinoou a pečenou zeleninou
title.en: Turkey and quinoa power bowl with roast vegetables

description.sk: Krabičkové jedlo s opečeným morčacím, quinoou, batátmi, brokolicou a citrónovou tahini omáčkou.
description.en: A meal prep bowl of seared turkey, quinoa, sweet potato and broccoli with a lemon tahini sauce.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Batát ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, brokolicu rozober na ružičky a cibuľu nakrájaj na mesiačiky. Premiešaj ich s 2 lyžicami oleja, polovicou soli a údenou paprikou a rozlož na plech s papierom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 2 cm cubes, break the broccoli into florets and cut the onion into wedges. Toss with 2 tablespoons of oil, half the salt and the smoked paprika and spread on a lined tray.

steps.sk: Zeleninu peč 25 minút, v polovici ju premiešaj, kým nie je mäkká a na okrajoch opečená. Medzitým prepláchni quinou v sitku a var ju so 400 ml vody pod pokrievkou 15 minút; potom ju nechaj 5 minút dôjsť.
steps.en: Roast the vegetables for 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until tender and browned at the edges. Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook it with 400 ml water, covered, for 15 minutes, then let it stand for 5.

steps.sk: Morčacie prsia nakrájaj na rezne hrubé 2 cm, posoľ zvyšnou soľou, okoreň a posyp cesnakovým práškom. Opeč ich na zvyšnom oleji na stredne silnom ohni 4 až 5 minút z každej strany, kým nemajú vnútri 74 °C, a nakrájaj na prúžky.
steps.en: Cut the turkey into 2 cm thick steaks and season with the remaining salt, the pepper and garlic powder. Fry in the remaining oil over a medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes on each side until 74 °C inside, then slice into strips.

steps.sk: Na omáčku rozmiešaj jogurt s tahini, citrónovou šťavou, štipkou soli a 2 lyžicami vody.
steps.en: For the sauce, stir the yogurt with the tahini, lemon juice, a pinch of salt and 2 tablespoons of water.

steps.sk: Do misiek rozdeľ špenát, quinou, pečenú zeleninu a morčacie a polej ich omáčkou. Misky sú ideálne na prípravu dopredu – v chladničke vydržia 4 dni, omáčku drž zvlášť.
steps.en: Divide the spinach, quinoa, roast vegetables and turkey between bowls and spoon over the sauce. The bowls are made for meal prep: they keep in the fridge for 4 days, with the sauce kept separate.

title.sk: Bolonská omáčka z červenej šošovice so špagetami

description.sk: Vegánska bolonská s červenou šošovicou, koreňovou zeleninou a vínom, hustá a sýta ako mäsová.
description.en: A vegan bolognese of red lentils, root vegetables and wine, as thick and hearty as the meat version.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler nakrájaj na veľmi drobné kocky a cesnak nadrobno. Šošovicu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra.
steps.en: Dice the onion, carrots and celery very finely and chop the garlic. Rinse the lentils in a sieve until the water runs clear.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej olej a zeleninu na ňom opekaj na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezačne zlatnúť. Pridaj cesnak a pretlak a miešaj 1 minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the vegetables over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft and starting to colour. Add the garlic and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Prilej víno a nechaj ho 2 minúty povrieť, potom pridaj šošovicu, paradajky, 500 ml vody, oregano, bobkový list, sójovú omáčku a ½ lyžičky soli. Var prikryté na miernom ohni 20 minút a občas premiešaj, kým šošovica nie je mäkká a omáčka hustá.
steps.en: Pour in the wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes, then add the lentils, tomatoes, 500 ml water, the oregano, bay leaf, soy sauce and ½ teaspoon of salt. Simmer, covered, over a low heat for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft and the sauce thick.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar špagety vo vode so zvyšnou soľou podľa návodu na obale. Odober šálku vody z cestovín a sceď ich.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in water with the remaining salt as the packet directs. Save a cup of the pasta water and drain.

steps.sk: Omáčku okoreň, vyber bobkový list a premiešaj ju so špagetami a trochou vody z cestovín. Posyp bazalkou. Víno a sójová omáčka jej dodajú mäsitú hĺbku; v chladničke vydrží 5 dní a výborne sa mrazí.
steps.en: Season the sauce with pepper, remove the bay leaf and toss with the spaghetti and a splash of the pasta water. Scatter with basil. The wine and soy sauce give it a meaty depth; it keeps in the fridge for 5 days and freezes very well.

title.sk: Burgery z čiernej fazule s avokádom

description.sk: Vegánske placky z čiernej fazule, ovsených vločiek a korenia v opečenej žemli s avokádom a zeleninou.
description.en: Vegan patties of black beans, oats and spices in a toasted bun with avocado and salad.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Fazuľu sceď, rozlož na plech s papierom a suš 10 minút v rúre – suchá fazuľa sa nerozpadne na kašu a burgery budú držať tvar. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a speň ju s cesnakom na lyžici oleja 5 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Drain the beans, spread them on a lined tray and dry them in the oven for 10 minutes; dry beans do not turn to mush, so the burgers hold their shape. Finely chop the onion and soften it with the garlic in a tablespoon of oil for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Fazuľu roztlač vidličkou tak, aby zostali aj polovičky zŕn, a zmiešaj ju s cibuľou, vločkami, rímskym kmínom, údenou paprikou, sójovou omáčkou, pretlakom a soľou. Nechaj zmes 10 minút postáť, vločky nasajú vlhkosť.
steps.en: Mash the beans with a fork, leaving some half beans, and mix with the onion, oats, cumin, smoked paprika, soy sauce, tomato paste and salt. Leave for 10 minutes so the oats soak up the moisture.

steps.sk: Mokrými rukami vytvaruj 4 placky hrubé 2 cm a daj ich na 15 minút do chladničky, aby sa spevnili.
steps.en: With wet hands, shape 4 patties 2 cm thick and chill them for 15 minutes to firm up.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej zvyšný olej na stredne silnom ohni a placky opekaj 4 až 5 minút z každej strany, kým nie sú chrumkavé a prehriate. Obracaj ich opatrne širokou obracačkou.
steps.en: Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the patties for 4 to 5 minutes on each side until crisp and hot through. Turn them carefully with a wide spatula.

steps.sk: Avokádo roztlač s limetkovou šťavou a štipkou soli. Žemle opeč, natri avokádom a vlož do nich burger, plátok paradajky, šalát a cibuľu. Surové placky sa dajú zamraziť a opekať priamo z mrazničky.
steps.en: Mash the avocado with the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Toast the buns, spread with the avocado and fill with a burger, tomato slice, lettuce and onion. Raw patties freeze well and can be fried from frozen.

title.sk: Arašidové rezance s tofu a zeleninou
title.en: Peanut noodles with tofu and crunchy vegetables

description.sk: Ryžové rezance v krémovej arašidovej omáčke so zázvorom, chrumkavým tofu a surovou zeleninou.
description.en: Rice noodles in a creamy peanut and ginger sauce with crispy tofu and raw vegetables.

steps.sk: Tofu osuš, nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm a obaľ ho v škrobe. Na panvici ho opekaj na oleji 8 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán chrumkavé.
steps.en: Pat the tofu dry, cut it into 2 cm cubes and toss in the cornflour. Fry it in the oil for 8 minutes until crisp on all sides.

steps.sk: Na omáčku rozmiešaj arašidové maslo so sójovou omáčkou, octom, cukrom, prelisovaným cesnakom, nastrúhaným zázvorom, srirachou, šťavou z limetky a 4 až 5 lyžicami horúcej vody na hladkú omáčku.
steps.en: For the sauce, whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, crushed garlic, grated ginger, sriracha, the lime juice and 4 to 5 tablespoons of hot water until smooth.

steps.sk: Rezance namoč alebo uvar podľa návodu na obale, sceď ich a prepláchni studenou vodou. Mrkvu, uhorku a papriku nakrájaj na tenké pásiky, jarnú cibuľku na kolieska a arašidy nasucho opraž a nahrubo posekaj.
steps.en: Soak or cook the noodles as the packet directs, drain and rinse with cold water. Cut the carrots, cucumber and pepper into thin strips and the spring onions into rounds, and dry-toast and roughly chop the peanuts.

steps.sk: Rezance premiešaj s omáčkou a zeleninou, aby bol každý rezanec obalený. Ak je omáčka príliš hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Toss the noodles with the sauce and vegetables until every strand is coated. Loosen with a little water if the sauce is too thick.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ ich do misiek, pridaj tofu a posyp arašidmi a koriandrom. Jedlo chutí teplé aj studené, preto je ideálne do krabičky; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Divide between bowls, add the tofu and scatter with peanuts and coriander. It is good warm or cold, which makes it ideal for packed lunches; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Miska s pečeným lososom, quinoou a avokádom
title.en: Salmon quinoa bowl with avocado and cucumber

description.sk: Losos v medovo-sójovej glazúre na quinoe so špenátom, avokádom, uhorkou a sezamovým dresingom.
description.en: Honey-soy glazed salmon on quinoa with spinach, avocado, cucumber and a sesame dressing.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Quinou prepláchni v sitku a var s 250 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút; potom ju nechaj 5 minút dôjsť.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and cook it with 250 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes, then let it stand for 5.

steps.sk: Sójovú omáčku zmiešaj s medom a polovicou natri lososa. Polož ho na plech s papierom kožou nadol a peč 12 až 14 minút, kým sa na najhrubšom mieste ľahko neoddeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce with the honey and brush half over the salmon. Lay it skin side down on a lined tray and bake for 12 to 14 minutes until it flakes easily at the thickest point.

steps.sk: Uhorku nakrájaj na polkolieska, mrkvu na tenké pásiky a avokádo na plátky. Na dresing zmiešaj zvyšnú sójovú zmes so sezamovým olejom, octom a šťavou z polovice limetky.
steps.en: Slice the cucumber into half-moons, the carrot into thin ribbons and the avocado into slices. For the dressing, mix the remaining soy and honey with the sesame oil, vinegar and the juice of half the lime.

steps.sk: Do misiek rozdeľ špenát a quinou a navrch daj lososa rozobraného na veľké kusy, zeleninu a avokádo.
steps.en: Divide the spinach and quinoa between bowls and top with the salmon broken into large pieces, the vegetables and avocado.

steps.sk: Polej dresingom a posyp sezamom a jarnou cibuľkou. Misky bez avokáda vydržia v chladničke 2 dni a losos chutí aj studený.
steps.en: Drizzle with the dressing and scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion. Without the avocado the bowls keep in the fridge for 2 days, and the salmon is good cold.

title.en: Turkey burgers with yogurt and cucumber sauce

description.sk: Šťavnaté placky z mletého morčacieho s údenou paprikou, v žemli s kôprovou jogurtovou omáčkou.
description.en: Juicy turkey burgers with smoked paprika in a bun with a dill yogurt sauce.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nastrúhaj najemno a cesnak prelisuj. Mäso zmiešaj s cibuľou, cesnakom, strúhankou, vajcom, horčicou, údenou paprikou, soľou a korením a vytvaruj 4 placky hrubé 2 cm, o niečo širšie ako žemle – pri pečení sa zmenšia.
steps.en: Finely grate the onion and crush the garlic. Mix the turkey with the onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, mustard, smoked paprika, salt and pepper and shape 4 patties 2 cm thick, slightly wider than the buns, as they shrink in the pan.

steps.sk: Do stredu každej placky urob palcom plytkú jamku, aby sa pri pečení nenafúkli do gule. Daj ich na 10 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Press a shallow dimple into the middle of each patty with your thumb so they do not puff into balls. Chill them for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej na stredne silnom ohni a burgery opekaj 5 až 6 minút z každej strany, kým nie sú hnedé a vnútri majú 74 °C. Morčacie musí byť prepečené, vnútri bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the burgers for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until browned and 74 °C inside. Turkey must be cooked through, with no pink in the middle.

steps.sk: Na omáčku uhorku nastrúhaj, vytlač a zmiešaj s jogurtom, kôprom a štipkou soli. Žemle rozkroj a opeč na suchej panvici.
steps.en: For the sauce, grate and squeeze the cucumber and mix it with the yogurt, dill and a pinch of salt. Split the buns and toast them in a dry pan.

steps.sk: Do žemlí daj šalát, burger, plátok paradajky, cibuľu a lyžicu omáčky. Upečené burgery vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a surové placky sa dajú zamraziť.
steps.en: Fill the buns with lettuce, a burger, a slice of tomato, onion and a spoonful of the sauce. Cooked burgers keep in the fridge for 3 days and raw patties freeze well.
